purpose: Packing inventory: you number a box, type what's in it, and the app stores it in localStorage; later you search "can opener" to find which box has it, and print a sheet of QR labels whose payload IS the box contents (base64 in the URL hash), so scanning a taped-on label at the new house opens a read-only "reveal" view with no server and no wifi.
structure: Single page, no routing except a hash mode. `body > div.wrap` (index.html:800) holds everything except the toast and footer. Inside: `header.app` (801) = 32px icon.svg + h1 "Moving Boxes" + `span.spacer` + `a#tipLink.tipbtn.hidden` (un-hidden by app.js:235-239). Then TWO mutually exclusive views, swapped by toggling `.hidden`: (a) `div#reveal.hidden` (809) containing `section.card.revealbox` with `div#revNum.num`, `div#revRoom.room`, `ul#revItems`, shown only when location.hash matches /^#b\./ (app.js:240-243, 154-163); (b) `div#main` (817), the normal app, containing three stacked `section.card`s: SEARCH card (818-821, `.screenonly`, no h2, just `input#searchInput[type=search]` + `ul.plain#searchResults`); PACK card (823-837, `.screenonly`, h2 "Pack a box", a `div.row` with a 90px-pinned `label.f` for `#boxNum` and a flexible `label.f` for `#boxRoom` + `datalist#roomList`, then a full-width `label.f` textarea `#boxItems`, then `button#addBox.btn.primary` forced to width:100% inline); BOXES card (839-850, NOT `.screenonly` so it prints, `h2#boxHead` whose text JS overwrites with the count, `ul.plain#boxList`, `p.hint#emptyHint`, a `div.row.screenonly` of three equal `.btn`s Print/Export/Import plus a `.hidden` file input, and a trailing `p.hint`). Then `div#labels` (853), `display:none` on screen, `display:grid` 2-up only in print. Outside the wrap: `div#toast[role=status][aria-live=polite]` (856) and `footer.colophon` (857). No `<main>`, no `<nav>`, no skip link, no modals, no sticky bar, no tabs. Main flow: type items → "Seal the box 📦" → row appears in Boxes → repeat → scroll to bottom → "Print QR labels" → tape labels → later, scan a label (reveal view) or search the app.
cssClasses: `.hero` / `.hero h2` / `.hero p`, intro block; UNUSED here (311-314)
`.trust` / `.trust svg` / `.trust b`, privacy stamp; UNUSED here (331-342)
`section.card > h2`, `.card > h2`, uppercase 12px micro card label (357)
`.card .sub`, card secondary text; adds 16px bottom margin (368)
`.em` / `.muted`, inline emphasis and muted color; unused (531-532)
`ul.plain > li`, 44px flex row with bottom divider (561)
`.skip`, skip link; styled but NOT PRESENT in markup (687)
`.boxnum`, box number chip, --accent fill, hardcoded 10px radius (769)
`#labels`, label sheet; display:none on screen, grid in print (782/786)
`.label`, printed label card, flex, 1.5pt border, 5mm pad (787)
`.label .lt` / `.ln` / `.lr` / `.li` / `.label img`, label text column, 26pt number, 11pt room, 8pt items, 30mm QR (791-795)
dynamicMarkup:
Everything below is built by `el()` (app.js:10-24) with NO template, class strings are literals in JS.

**renderBoxes (app.js:68-99)** rebuilds `ul#boxList` with `el('li', {}, ...)`, **the `<li>` carries no class at all**; every bit of its row layout comes from the descendant selector `ul.plain > li` (index.html:561). Each li holds: `span.boxnum` (text `#N`), `div.grow` > (bare `div` > `strong` with room-or-"Unlabeled room") + `div.sub` (items joined by ", " or "empty?"), then `button.btn.small.screenonly[type=button][aria-label="Edit box"]` with text `✎`, then `button.btn.small.danger.screenonly[type=button][aria-label="Delete box"]` with text `✕`. Same function also: toggles `.hidden` on `#emptyHint` (71), overwrites `#boxHead.textContent` with "N boxes · M things" (72-74), and sets `#boxNum.placeholder` (98).

**renderSearch (app.js:101-115)** rebuilds `ul#searchResults` with classless `el('li')` > `span.boxnum` + `div.grow` > (bare `div` > `strong`) + `div.sub` containing either the literal "Has: " plus `span.hit` (the matched item names) or the first five items. Capped at 10 with `hits.slice(0,10)`.

**renderRoomList (app.js:61-66)** fills `datalist#roomList` with bare `<option value=room>`, no classes.

**renderLabels (app.js:136-152)** rebuilds `div#labels` with `div.label` > `div.lt` > (`div.ln` = `#N`, `div.lr` = room, `div.li` = first 4 items joined by " · " plus " …"), followed by either `img[alt="QR for box N"][src=data:image/png]` or, on QR failure, a fallback `div.li` reading "(QR too large, trim the item list)". Called on the Print button (198) and on `beforeprint` (167).

**qrDataUrl (app.js:117-134)** builds an off-DOM `<canvas>` sized `(moduleCount + 8) * 4` px, fills `#fff` then `#000` per module (cell=4, quiet=4), returns a PNG data URL. The canvas never enters the DOM.

**showScanned (app.js:154-163)** adds `.hidden` to `#main`, removes it from `#reveal`, sets `#revNum`/`#revRoom` textContent, and fills `ul#revItems` with classless `<li>` per item, or a single `li.sub` reading "(nothing listed)".

**toast (app.js:26-32)** sets `#toast.textContent` then adds/removes `.show`.

**export (app.js:201-207)** appends a bare `<a download>` to `document.body` for ~500ms, then removes it.

**init (app.js:235-239)** removes `.hidden` from `#tipLink` and sets its href.

**Buttons whose label JS rewrites wholesale:** `$('addBox').textContent = 'Update box #N 📦'` (87) and `= 'Seal the box 📦'` (180); `$('boxHead').textContent` (72). Any restyle that puts an icon `<span>` or nested label element inside those elements will be erased on first interaction.

**Silent specificity collision:** the injected `div.sub` sits inside `section.card`, so `.card .sub` (index.html:368, specificity 0-2-0) beats `.sub` (573, 0-1-0) and applies `margin:0 0 16px` to every box row and every search result.

comfortDefects.issue: The per-app geometry from skins.mjs is dead. The skin block sets `--r:10px` and `--wrap:44rem`, then the base layer re-declares `--r:14px` and `--wrap:42rem` in a later `:root` at equal specificity, so the base wins. This app renders at the generic 14px radius and 42rem width, not its intended crisp-kraft 10px/44rem. Confirmed identical in design/out/moving-boxes.css:16-17 vs 156/172, a portfolio-wide generator bug, not just this app.
comfortDefects.where: index.html:34-35 overridden by index.html:174 and index.html:190
comfortDefects.fix: In design/build.mjs, emit the skin tokens AFTER studio.css's `:root`, or strip `--r`/`--wrap` defaults from studio.css:45,61 and make the skin the only source. Then `.boxnum`'s hardcoded 10px radius (index.html:770) can become `var(--r-sm)`.

comfortDefects.issue: Row dividers are invisible. `ul.plain > li` uses `border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)` and --line (#e8dbc7) against --surface (#fffdfb) computes to 1.34:1. In a 40-box list there is no perceivable separation between rows.
comfortDefects.fix: Use --line-2 (3.32:1) for list dividers, or alternate row backgrounds with --surface-2. Reserve --line for card outlines only.

comfortDefects.issue: The search-match highlight does not read as a highlight. `.hit` paints `var(--chip)` → --surface-2 (#fcf3e5) on the card's --surface (#fffdfb): 1.08:1. The single most important pixel in the app, which item matched, is functionally unstyled.
comfortDefects.fix: Use --accent-soft with a 1px --accent-line border, or bottom-border underline in --accent. Also add vertical padding: `padding:0 4px` gives the chip zero height presence.

comfortDefects.issue: The reveal card has 8px of horizontal padding. `.revealbox{padding:26px 8px}` appears after `.card{padding:var(--s5)}` and after the ≥30rem `padding:var(--s6)` media query, at equal specificity, so it wins on all viewports. Text in the app's proudest screen sits 8px from the card edge.
comfortDefects.fix: Change to `padding:var(--s7) var(--s5)` and let the card's own responsive padding apply, or scope the override to a media query.

comfortDefects.issue: Injected `div.sub` picks up a 16px bottom margin from `.card .sub` (0-2-0) instead of the intended flat `.sub` (0-1-0). Every box row and search result is 16px taller than designed and the `.boxnum` chip no longer optically centers against its text.
comfortDefects.where: index.html:368 vs index.html:573, consumed by app.js:80 and app.js:110
comfortDefects.fix: Change index.html:368 to `.card > .sub` so it only affects direct children of a card, or give row secondary text a distinct class like `.row-sub`.

comfortDefects.issue: The row action buttons are under the system's own 44px target. `.btn.small` is 36px tall and, with `padding:0 var(--s3)` around a single glyph, roughly 34px wide. The `✎` and `✕` are separated by only 12px (the li's `gap:var(--s3)`).
comfortDefects.where: index.html:483, applied at app.js:81 and app.js:91
comfortDefects.fix: Use `.btn.icon` (index.html:489, already 44×44 and unused) for these two, and raise the gap between them to var(--s4).

comfortDefects.issue: Tip jar is a 36px tap target in the header, below --tap:44px which the same stylesheet declares as the minimum a thumb wants.
comfortDefects.fix: Raise to var(--tap) or keep the 36px visual pill inside a 44px hit area via a transparent ::after inset.

comfortDefects.issue: The app's primary status readout is styled as a micro-label. `#boxHead` is an `h2` inside a card, so `section.card > h2` renders "12 boxes · 87 things" at --t-micro (12px), uppercase, 0.075em tracking, in --ink-2. The count you most want to glance at is the smallest text on the page.
comfortDefects.where: index.html:357 applied to index.html:840, text set by app.js:72-74
comfortDefects.fix: Split the count out of the h2 into a `.tnum` stat line at --t-lg/--ink, and leave the h2 as a static "BOXES" label.

comfortDefects.issue: Two multi-clause instructional sentences are set at --t-xs (13px), which the base layer reserves for hints and labels. These are the app's only onboarding copy.
comfortDefects.fix: Promote to --t-sm (15px) minimum; move #emptyHint into the unused `.empty` component (index.html:578) where `.empty p` is already --t-sm.

comfortDefects.issue: A box row's item list is rendered unbounded: `b.items.join(', ')` with up to 100 items × 60 chars. Inside `.grow{overflow-wrap:anywhere}` a single row can become 15+ wrapped lines, destroying the list's scannability.
comfortDefects.fix: Clamp to 2 lines with `-webkit-line-clamp:2; display:-webkit-box; overflow:hidden`, or truncate in JS to the first 6 items plus "+N more" (the reveal view already shows the full list).

comfortDefects.issue: No hierarchy in the action row: "Print QR labels" (the app's entire payoff and the reason to use it over a notebook), "Export backup", and "Import" are three identical `.btn`s. On a phone `.row > *{flex:1 1 12rem}` wraps them into three identical full-width stacked bars.
comfortDefects.fix: Print becomes `.btn.primary`; Export/Import become `.btn.ghost` in a `.cluster`, visually demoted and grouped as backup utilities.

comfortDefects.issue: Hardcoded pixel values off the 4px scale scattered through the app layer, which will fight any new spacing rhythm: 8px/6px padding and 10px radius on `.boxnum`, 6px/4px on `.hit`, 26px/8px on `.revealbox`, 12px on `.room`, and an inline 10px margin-top.
comfortDefects.where: index.html:770, 774, 776, 778, and inline style at index.html:843
comfortDefects.fix: Replace with --s2/--s3/--s5/--s7 and --r-sm/--r-ctl tokens before the palette swap, so the overhaul only has to change token values.

comfortDefects.issue: Printed item text is 8pt in #666 grey. These labels get read at arm's length by someone holding a box, often in bad light in an empty room.
comfortDefects.fix: Raise to 9.5pt in #333 and drop from 4 items to 3 to keep the label height.

comfortDefects.issue: `background-attachment:fixed` on a repeating 26px grid forces a full-viewport repaint on every scroll frame; iOS Safari also renders it with visible jitter/banding against the address-bar collapse.
comfortDefects.fix: Drop `background-attachment:fixed`, a 26px tiled grid looks identical scrolling with the page and costs nothing.

comfortDefects.issue: No visual gap between the search input and its results. `ul.plain{margin:0}` means results begin 8px (the li's own padding) below the field, so results read as part of the input rather than as a response to it.
comfortDefects.fix: Add margin-top var(--s4) to #searchResults when populated, and a hairline rule above the first result.

navigationDefects.issue: A first-time visitor gets no explanation. The first thing on screen after the header is a bare search box whose placeholder is a joke about a can opener, searching an empty inventory. Nothing states what the app does, that labels are printable, or that the QR carries the contents. The base layer's `.hero` component exists and is unused.
navigationDefects.where: index.html:817-821 (search card is the first child of #main); `.hero` at index.html:311-314
navigationDefects.fix: Add a `.hero` above the search card: h2 "Which box has the can opener?" plus one sentence on QR labels. On a cold start (boxes.length === 0), hide the search card entirely, it can only disappoint.

navigationDefects.issue: The empty state is one 13px grey sentence, not a teaching state. The base layer ships a full `.empty` component (glyph + h3 + p + room for a CTA) that this app never uses.
navigationDefects.where: index.html:842 (#emptyHint as `p.hint`), toggled at app.js:71; unused `.empty` at index.html:578-599
navigationDefects.fix: Replace #emptyHint with `.empty` markup: 📦 glyph, h3 "No boxes yet", p explaining the flow, and a button that focuses #boxItems.

navigationDefects.issue: Print, the whole point of the app, is buried at the bottom of an unbounded list. With 40 boxes the user must scroll past 40 rows to reach the Print button. The base layer's sticky `.actionbar` exists and is unused, and there is no back-to-top affordance on a page that has no other landmarks.
navigationDefects.where: index.html:843-846 (action row sits after `ul#boxList`); unused `.actionbar` at index.html:652
navigationDefects.fix: Move Print/Export/Import into an `.actionbar` sticky to the bottom of the Boxes card, or promote Print into the card header row next to #boxHead.

navigationDefects.issue: Import destroys the entire inventory with no confirmation and no undo. The handler assigns `boxes = arr...` outright, overwriting every existing box, and it is triggered by a plain `.btn` labelled just "Import" sitting 8px from "Export backup" in a row of three identical buttons. There is no merge option and no pre-import snapshot.
navigationDefects.fix: When boxes.length > 0, confirm(`Replace all N boxes with this backup?`) before assigning; better, offer merge-by-number. Stash the pre-import array and offer "Undo import" in the toast for 10s.

navigationDefects.issue: Delete is irreversible and silent. After confirm() the box is filtered out, saved, and re-rendered with no toast at all, the only unannounced mutation in the app (add/update/import/export all toast).
navigationDefects.where: app.js:91-96 (no toast() call in the onclick)
navigationDefects.fix: Toast "Box #N deleted" with an Undo action that re-inserts the captured object; screen readers currently get nothing at all.

navigationDefects.issue: The destructive control sits immediately beside the benign one at the far end of every row, both ~34×36px with a 12px gap. Scrolling a long list on a phone puts a delete button under the thumb on every single row.
navigationDefects.where: app.js:81 (✎) and app.js:91 (✕), sized by index.html:483
navigationDefects.fix: Separate them: keep ✎ inline, move ✕ behind a swipe or an overflow menu; at minimum enlarge to 44px and increase the gap between the two.

navigationDefects.issue: Edit mode cannot be cancelled. Clicking ✎ sets editingBoxId and rewrites the button to "Update box #N", but there is no cancel control and no visual state on the card, the h2 still reads "Pack a box". navigationDefects.issue: The scanned-label view is a dead end. showScanned hides #main permanently; there is no link back to the inventory, no way to clear the hash, and the reveal view returns early before load() ever runs. Someone who scans a label and then wants to check another box has to hand-edit the URL.

navigationDefects.fix: Add a persistent "← Open my inventory" link inside #reveal that clears location.hash and re-runs the normal init path.

navigationDefects.issue: The user is never told their work is saved. save() writes to localStorage silently and only speaks up on failure. Its only name is a placeholder that is also its only instruction, and the placeholder computes to 3.39:1 (--ink-3 #92877a on --field #fffaf4), below 4.5:1. It also vanishes the moment the user types, taking the instruction with it. The card wrapping it has no h2 either, so there is no contextual heading to fall back on.

The injected edit and delete buttons carry the static labels "Edit box" and "Delete box" with no box number, so a screen-reader user tabbing a 30-box list hears "Edit box, Delete box, Edit box, Delete box…" with nothing to distinguish them. The visible glyphs ✎ and ✕ are overridden by the aria-label, so the number never surfaces.

a11yDefects.issue: Search results are never announced. `#searchResults` has no aria-live, no role=status, and no result count, so typing into the search field updates the DOM in total silence for a screen-reader user, and search is the app's headline feature. a11yDefects.fix:
Add a visually-hidden `

a11yDefects.issue: The scanned-label view has no heading. `#revNum` (the box number) and `#revRoom` are `<div>`s, so the reveal screen offers exactly one heading, the h1 "Moving Boxes", and then an unstructured blob. Someone navigating by headings after scanning a label lands on nothing useful, and the document title is never updated to name the box either.
a11yDefects.fix:
Make #revNum an `

` and #revRoom an `

`, give `ul#revItems` an aria-labelledby pointing at #revNum, and set `document.title = 'Box #' + box.n` in showScanned.

a11yDefects.issue: Lists lose their semantics in Safari. `ul.plain` and `.revealbox ul` both set `list-style:none`, which makes WebKit strip the list role, so VoiceOver stops announcing "list, 12 items" and item positions for the box list, the search results, and the scanned contents, the three places where count matters most.
a11yDefects.fix: Add `role="list"` to `ul#boxList`, `ul#searchResults` and `ul#revItems` in the markup (index.html:820, 841, 813).

a11yDefects.issue: The validation error is unfocused and unassociated. Clicking "Seal the box" with an empty item list fires a polite toast and nothing else, focus stays on the button, #boxItems gets no aria-invalid and no aria-describedby, and no inline message appears near the field that is actually wrong.

a11yDefects.issue: The inventory count changes with no announcement. `#boxHead` is overwritten with "12 boxes · 87 things" on every add, edit, delete and import, but it is a plain h2 with no aria-live, so the one piece of feedback confirming an import restored 40 boxes is inaudible (the import toast covers that case; add/delete counts are not covered).
a11yDefects.fix: Split the count into its own `<span aria-live="polite">` inside the card so heading text stays stable and only the number is announced.

a11yDefects.issue: Icon-button hit area is below the system's own minimum. `.btn.small` gives 36px height and ~34px width for a single-glyph button, under the `--tap:44px` that this very stylesheet defines at index.html:188 as the comfortable minimum, and delete is one of the two.
a11yDefects.where: index.html:483 applied at app.js:81 and app.js:91
a11yDefects.fix: Apply the already-defined `.btn.icon` (index.html:489 to 44×44) to both, so the class string becomes `btn small icon screenonly`, or drop `.small` entirely.

a11yDefects.issue: The toast's announcement depends on `visibility`, not `display`. `#toast` is `visibility:hidden` by default and made visible by the `.show` class in the same tick that textContent is set. This currently works, but it is a fragile contract: a restyle that switches the hide mechanism to `display:none`, or that moves the text into a child element, silently kills every status announcement in the app, including the storage-full warning.
a11yDefects.fix: Keep the live region permanently in the a11y tree: render the toast text into a separate always-present `.sr-only` node, and let the visual toast be purely decorative with aria-hidden.

printSupport:
Print is the core use case, the app exists to produce a sheet of QR labels you tape to boxes, and the README leads with it. There are two `@media print` blocks: the shared base one at index.html:725-756 (resets tokens to black-on-white, hides `header.app`/`footer.colophon`/`.tipbtn`/`.actionbar`/`#toast`/`.seg`/`.skip`/`.noprint`/`.no-print`/`.screenonly`, forces `break-inside:avoid` on cards/rows/list items, `a{color:#000}`, `@page{margin:14mm}`), and the app one at index.html:783-796 which flips `#labels` from `display:none` to a 2-column grid with 6mm gap and defines the label card. `renderLabels()` is bound to both the Print button (app.js:196-200) and the `beforeprint` event (app.js:167), so Ctrl/Cmd+P produces current labels rather than stale ones, that part is done well.

What is broken or missing:

1. **No on-screen preview.** `#labels{display:none}` (index.html:782) means the user never sees the artifact before the browser print dialog. In an app whose entire output is a printed sheet, the first sight of the layout is the OS preview, and there is no way to check a label without committing to a print.

2. **Label text can overflow its box.** `.label .li` (index.html:793) receives up to 4 items joined with " · ", each up to 60 chars (helpers.js:15), potentially 250+ characters at 8pt in a text column of roughly 45mm (91mm column − 10mm padding − 5mm gap − 30mm QR). There is no `overflow:hidden`, no line clamp, and no `word-break`. A box with long item names produces a tall, ragged label; room names can run to 40 chars (index.html:829 maxlength) at 11pt in the same column and will wrap.

3. **No page control on the label sheet.** `#labels` has no `break-before:page`, and the Boxes card is *not* `.screenonly`, so printing emits the box list as a manifest (with `#boxHead` rendered as 12px uppercase micro-type) and then flows labels immediately after it on the same page. Whether the manifest is wanted is undocumented; either way it should start the labels on a fresh sheet.

4. **Hardcoded print colors bypass the print token block.** `.label` uses literal `#111`, `#444`, `#666` (index.html:788-793) rather than the `--ink`/`--ink-2`/`--ink-3` values the base print block sets at index.html:728-733, so retuning print contrast portfolio-wide will not reach the labels.

5. **No `print-color-adjust:exact` anywhere.** Today's labels are near-black so nothing is lost, but the moment the overhaul adds a colored label header or an accent rule, browsers will silently drop it.

6. **QR resampling risk.** The canvas is `(moduleCount + 8) × 4` px (app.js:123-126) and is then scaled to a fixed 30mm (index.html:794). A 900-char payload lands around 105 modules → 420px, downscaled to ~354px at 300dpi; with no `image-rendering` declared, the browser applies smooth interpolation to module edges. It scans today, but it has no margin.

7. **No `@page{size:...}`.** The 2-column math assumes Letter (188mm content) but silently gets 182mm on A4, narrowing each column by 3mm. Fine now, tight if label padding grows.

8. **Printing with zero boxes emits an empty grid.** The Print button guards on `boxes.length === 0` (app.js:197), but the `beforeprint` path (app.js:167) does not, so browser-menu printing an empty app yields a page with the Boxes card and nothing else.
riskyToRestyle: **Box rows and search results have NO class on the `<li>`.** `el('li', {}, ...)` at app.js:76 and app.js:106 relies entirely on the descendant selector `ul.plain > li` (index.html:561) for flex layout, 44px min-height, gap and divider. If the overhaul renames `ul.plain`, scopes rows to a `.list-row`/`.row-item` class, or changes the child combinator, every box row collapses to an unstyled block with the number chip, text and both buttons stacked vertically. This is the single highest-risk coupling in the app.

**`.card .sub` (index.html:368) already beats `.sub` (index.html:573) on the injected `div.sub`.** Any change to either rule's specificity or margin silently changes row height in `#boxList`, `#searchResults`, and the `li.sub` in the reveal view (app.js:80, 110, 162). Verify row rhythm after touching either.

**`textContent` assignment wipes button children.** app.js:87 and app.js:180 overwrite `#addBox` entirely (`'Update box #N 📦'` / `'Seal the box 📦'`), and app.js:72 overwrites `#boxHead`. If the restyle wraps button labels in a `<span>`, adds an SVG icon slot, or inserts a `::before` content hook that depends on inner markup, the first click erases it.

**`.hidden{display:none !important}` is the app's only show/hide primitive**, used for the view swap (app.js:155-156), the empty hint (app.js:71), the tip jar (app.js:238) and the file input (index.html:847). The class name AND the `!important` must survive, `.revealbox`/`#labels` rules would otherwise win over a non-important `display:none`.

**`#labels` is `display:none` on screen and `display:grid` only inside `@media print`** (index.html:782 vs 786). Giving `#labels` any screen layout, a preview grid, a card wrapper, a `display:flex` reset, will either dump raw QR PNGs into the page or double-render the label sheet. If a preview is added, gate it explicitly rather than relaxing the `display:none`.

**Print label geometry is exact millimetres and is not responsive.** `grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr` + `gap:6mm` + `.label{padding:5mm; gap:5mm}` + `img{width:30mm;height:30mm}` (index.html:786-794) all budget against `@page{margin:14mm}` (index.html:755). Changing the @page margin, the label padding, or the QR size overflows the text column (currently ~45mm) and can push to 1 label per row. Re-measure on both Letter and A4 after any print-token change.

**The QR canvas has fixed module math and no `image-rendering`.** app.js:123-126 uses `cell = 4`, `quiet = 4`, size `(count + 8) * 4`. Do not add `border-radius`, `filter`, `opacity`, `mix-blend-mode`, a background, or a non-square aspect-ratio to `.label img`, and do not shrink it below 30mm without also lowering `encodeBoxForLabel`'s 900-char cap (helpers.js:56), which is what keeps module density scannable at that size.

**`.screenonly` is the print contract and is applied from JS.** app.js:81 and app.js:91 hardcode it in the class strings of the injected edit/delete buttons, alongside markup uses at index.html:818, 823, 842, 843, 849. It is matched in two separate print blocks (index.html:741 and index.html:785). Renaming it to `.no-print` in the base layer would leave the JS-injected buttons printing on every label sheet.

**The app layer depends on legacy token aliases slated for removal.** `.hit` uses `var(--chip)` (index.html:774) and `.revealbox .room` uses `var(--muted)` (index.html:778); both are declared only in the legacy-alias block at index.html:79-89, which is explicitly documented as transitional. Deleting those aliases makes the search highlight transparent and the reveal room name fall back to inherited ink. Migrate to `--surface-2` and `--ink-2` first.

**Four inline styles override any class-based rule.** index.html:826 `flex:0 0 90px` pins the Box # field to exactly 90px (which, at `padding:var(--s3)`, leaves 66px of content, growing --s3 or the border breaks it); index.html:836 `width:100%` duplicates the unused `.btn.block`; index.html:843 `margin-top:10px` is off the spacing scale; index.html:857 `color:inherit` defeats the footer link color rule. None of these can be fixed from the stylesheet.

**`.revealbox` (index.html:776) overrides `.card` padding at equal specificity by source order**, including the ≥30rem responsive bump at index.html:353. If the overhaul moves card padding into a different rule, reorders the app layer, or raises card specificity, the reveal view's padding silently flips from 26px/8px to the card default, a visible change to the app's showcase screen.

**Tests are logic-only and assert nothing about the DOM.** test/helpers.test.mjs exercises `nextBoxNumber`, `parseItems`, `searchBoxes`, `encodeBox`/`decodeBox` and `encodeBoxForLabel` (including a hard `enc.length <= 900` assertion at line 50), no class names, no markup, no selectors. So the suite will stay green through a restyle that completely breaks the UI. There is no regression net here; visual and print verification must be manual.
